summary: The kubelite restart waits for readiness: /readyz on apiserver nodes, and a post-restart Ready heartbeat on workers, which kubelet v1.35.6 source confirms a restarted kubelet always posts. Every notifier now reaches the handler from a one-node-at-a-time play, the certs playbook split included, so V11–V13 are met in code. One advisory finding: the worker probe's kubectl call has no per-attempt timeout.

findings.summary: Worker readiness probe calls kubectl with no --request-timeout (default: none), so a hung request can outlast microk8s_kubelite_ready_timeout without failing the handler
